name: illustrator-vector-panel
description: CEP vector tracing panel for Adobe Illustrator

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && esbuild src/panel.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=iife --target=chrome99 --outfile=extension/js/panel.js && esbuild src/demo.ts --bundle --platform=browser --format=iife --target=chrome99 --outfile=demo/editor.js
scripts.test: esbuild src/color/model.test.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --target=node18 --outfile=dist/model.test.cjs && esbuild src/color/trace.test.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --target=node18 --outfile=dist/trace.test.cjs && node --test dist/model.test.cjs dist/trace.test.cjs
